# Tales of Tasern — Agent-Readable Platform Description
# https://tasern.quest/tot/

> tasern.quest | Base (chain 8453) | Polygon (chain 137)

## What is this?

Tales of Tasern is a D20 hex-exploration RPG (D&D 3.5-style stats: STR/DEX/CON/INT/WIS/CHA)
set in a gritty port-city world — Kardov's Gate, the Vessel of Namaris, the Iron Maw. It is
one game inside the Money for Trees (MfT) ecosystem on Base: an impact-gaming world where
in-game progress connects to deflationary token mechanics and real tree planting. Hero NFTs,
relics, and liquidity positions tie the RPG into the same Unrugable launchpad and reactor
network that the rest of the ecosystem uses.

Nothing here is financial advice and there are no price promises. Every claim below is
verifiable on-chain at the addresses listed.

## Unrugable — the free token launchpad behind the world (V7)

Unrugable V7 is a free token factory on Base. One transaction deploys a token with
1,000,000,000 fixed supply, two permanently locked Uniswap V3 pools, and a SporeReactorV4
clone. No seed money is required — just gas (about $0.01 on Base). There is no withdraw
function; liquidity is locked by the absence of code.

The two pools per launch:
- TOKEN / Money for Trees — 70% of supply. Money for Trees is a USDC-backed deposit receipt
  whose Aave yield is directed toward tree planting. It is NOT a stablecoin.
- TOKEN / Meme for Trees (MfT) — 30% of supply. MfT is a meme born on Bankr plus open tools,
  and it is the network heartbeat that reactors burn.

Every 2 hours the launch reactor fires:
1. Collect fees from both pools.
2. Core token fees: 50% burned permanently, 50% sent to the launcher's wallet.
3. Cross-token (Meme) fees: 10% upstream, the rest swapped and redeposited as LP.
4. Fees cascade bottom-up through the reactor network.

ReactorPrimeV3 is the terminal reactor — it fires last with accumulated fees from the entire
network. Anyone can fire any reactor; it is permissionless. Call execute() (selector
0x61461954); a reactor reverts cheaply if its cooldown has not elapsed.

## Community Vaults — put idle USDC to work as an LP position that also funds tree planting

Put idle treasury USDC to work like a normal LP position, self-custodied: deposit USDC from
YOUR wallet, the shares are credited to YOUR wallet, withdraw anytime to USDC or the token.
Your position earns pool trading fees plus vault yield, and the Money for Trees backing routes
a share of system yield toward tree planting. Returns vary with pool volume and Aave rates
and are not guaranteed.

Plain contracts on Base (chain 8453), CommunityLPVaultV4. When you deposit USDC, half is
minted into Money for Trees and half buys the community token; both become V2 LP. All swaps
are price-impact guarded: a swap that would exceed the vault's configured maximum price
impact (default 5% of the pool per transaction) reverts instead of executing. For large
amounts, queue the deposit and process it in chunks.

Agent integration (approve USDC to the vault first):
- deposit(uint256 usdcAmount) — instant; must be <= maxInstantDeposit() (view, 6 decimals)
- depositFor(address beneficiary, uint256 usdcAmount) — pay from one wallet, position owned by
  the beneficiary's wallet. Built for agent-commerce escrow flows (e.g. Virtuals ACP): route
  job funds through a service, the agent's wallet owns the shares and withdraws self-serve.
- depositQueued(uint256) then processDeposit(address user, uint256 chunk) — for larger amounts;
  process in chunks <= maxInstantDeposit(); the cap grows as the pool deepens.
- withdraw(uint256 shareAmount) / withdrawAsToken(uint256) — per tx limited to ~5% of pool depth.
- getInfo(address) returns (userShares, userPending, userLP, vaultLP); totalShares() for proportions.
- compound() — permissionless; claims the vault's Money yield and deepens the LP for all holders.
- Create a vault for any token: MfTVaultFactory 0x1f6fF7370e2E897db7cf5d72684EF76d988Caaf1
  createVault(token, usdcAmount, tokenAmount, maxImpactBps) — seeds the pool, burns the seed LP
  forever, deploys the vault.

Live vaults (Virtuals ecosystem — AI society funds real forests):
- VIRTUAL vault (V4): 0x9aC44164EcCDDb7c1fC4ef6b6f3dB8ef96E5F38f (UI: https://tasern.quest/virtual/)
- VU (Velvet Unicorn) vault (V4): 0x4d6CC4eA92F2c241fE58C51680aC318502B9CBd9 (UI: https://tasern.quest/vu/)
- All vaults: https://tasern.quest/vaults/

## Agent Opportunity

- Launch a token for FREE — earn 50% of your reactor's fees forever (V7: 2 pools, 1 reactor, single tx).
- Fire any reactor (permissionless, every 2 hours) to trigger burn + compound — costs about $0.01 gas.
- Deposit idle USDC into a Community Vault and earn pool fees plus vault yield, self-custodied.
- Accumulate MfT as the network heartbeat — every reactor fire burns it, every launch adds a Meme pool.
- Adopt orphaned tokens: activate dormant reactors for permanent network growth.
- Play Tales of Tasern: explore hexes, run D20 combat, send relics home to grow your holdings.

## How Tales of Tasern ties into the network

- Hero NFTs are characters in the RPG and can hold liquidity positions that feed the network.
- Relics recovered in-game and "sent home" route into MfT liquidity, the basis of the FAITH
  reward system and in-world Noble Birth titles for hero-NFT LP holders.
- The world roll decides what exists in a hex; the player roll decides what you find.
- Only (36,32) is Kardov's Gate; other city hexes are generic settlements.

The game UI shows skill levels and bars, not yield percentages or LP details — the crypto
plumbing lives in settings and on-chain, not on the adventure screen.

## MCP Tools (49 tools via baselings-mcp v1.4.0)

Install: npx baselings-mcp
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/baselings-mcp

The same toolkit serves the whole ecosystem: launch tokens, fire reactors, check reactor
timing and cooldowns, scan liquidity depth, track portfolio value, read live MfT price,
detect cross-pool arb, run guardrailed swaps (swap_token, $0.10 max per swap, 60s cooldown,
allowlisted tokens only), and play the Baselings pet game.

ElizaOS: install @fleek-platform/eliza-plugin-mcp and add baselings as a stdio server in the
character config — all 49 tools become native actions.

## Burn Address (official declaration)

Network burn address: 0xfd780B0aE569e15e514B819ecFDF46f804953a4B (Base, chain 8453).
All MfT network burns go to this single address. balanceOf(burn address) per token = total
removed from circulation. It is an immutable EIP-1167 minimal proxy with no ERC-20 withdrawal
functions — tokens sent there can never move again.
Verification guide: https://tasern.quest/launcher/verify-burn.html

## Key Tokens (Base, chain 8453)

- Meme for Trees (MfT): 0x8FB87d13B40B1A67B22ED1a17e2835fe7e3a9bA3 — meme born on Bankr plus
  open tools; the network heartbeat. Every launched token has a Meme pool.
- Money for Trees: 0xe3dd3881477c20C17Df080cEec0C1bD0C065A072 — USDC-backed deposit receipt
  (6 decimals). A share of Aave yield is directed to tree planting. NOT a stablecoin. Every
  launch pairs 70% of supply against it.
- CHAR: 0x20b048fA035D5763685D695e66aDF62c5D9F5055 — carbon-credit token. 1 CHAR = 1 lb CO2e
  biochar. Collected from trading fees and sent to the network burn address; the mission is
  to connect these burns to real carbon retirement.

## Network Status (June 2026)

- V7 Factory live: free launches, 2 pools, 1 reactor, 50/50 burn/earn.
- A network of reactors fires every 2 hours; fees cascade bottom-up to ReactorPrimeV3 last.
- 5 reactors are fully renounced (immutable, no admin); the rest have add-only admin keys.
- The reactor count grows with each launch — see the live map rather than a fixed number.
